# chalk_gcp_cloud_credentials (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk GCP cloud credentials object by ID. Surfaces project/region/service-account identity; deliberately omits nested docker_build_config / secretmanager_config / region_config blocks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud credentials identifier.

### Read-Only

- `gcp_management_service_account` (String)
- `gcp_project_id` (String)
- `gcp_region` (String)
- `name` (String)
